slides.headline: THINGS YOU DIDN'T KNOW *AI could do*
slides.body: Part 1. Five I actually used this week. Not one of them is a chatbot.
slides.close: Number 2 is the one *nobody believes until they try it*.

slides.headline: FIX *garbage audio* FOR FREE
slides.body: Drop in a recording with room echo or a bad mic and it comes back sounding like it was done in a studio.

slides.headline: FIND *any spoken phrase* ON YOUTUBE
slides.body: Type a phrase and it searches across more than a billion videos and hands you the exact timestamp where someone said it.

slides.headline: MAKE IMAGES WITH *readable text*
slides.body: Most image models turn words into scrambled letters. This one renders text you can actually read.
slides.close: Which means it makes *your covers and your thumbnails*.

slides.headline: TURN A PHOTO INTO *a video clip*
slides.body: Upload a still, describe the motion you want, and get a few seconds of moving footage back.
slides.close: This is where most of the b roll you scroll past *actually comes from*.

slides.headline: STRIP THE MUSIC OFF *any clip*
slides.body: Separates the voice from the background track so you can keep only the part you wanted.

slides.headline: COMMENT *HIDDEN*
slides.body: I will send you all five with the links, no hunting required.
slides.close: Free, no email needed. Save this and *send it to someone who thinks AI is just chatbots*.
